content: Autoplay policies: iOS WKWebView honors muted/no-audio-track autoplay without gesture; if a video gains an audio track or becomes unmuted WITHOUT a user gesture, playback PAUSES (WebKit blog 'New video policies for iOS', Jer Noble, 2016; still the operating model). WKWebView needs allowsInlineMediaPlayback=true + playsinline attr on iPhone (default false on iPhone, true on iPad). Android WebView default mediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture=true BLOCKS autoplay unless native wrapper sets false (Android WebSettings docs + AdMob guides). Engine in v1 has no native wrapper control: must be robust to both autoplay-allowed and autoplay-blocked containers, and must NEVER unmute programmatically (iOS pauses playback).
